coverage_rows.canon_label: Validation-pass report identity and lineage
coverage_rows.heading_hint: ## Research Progress - 2026-03-16 - Validation-pass report identity and lineage
exact_items: Validation-pass evidence identity must use canonical (`run_id`, `node_id`, `attempt_id`, `validation_pass_id`, `validation_event_ref`) and not rely on informal aggregation of messages or reports without explicit identity-bearing proof records
Validation-pass report must carry (`run_id`, `node_id`, `attempt_id`) lineage in document headers and footers so downstream readers know which attempt produced the evidence
Validation-pass report must surface and link related attempts (retry siblings, skipped precedents, promoted ancestors)
Validation-pass evidence and report must not be confused with ad hoc narrative logs; they are durable records with formal structure and identity
Show in Evidence / Show in Validation-pass Report / Show in Ledger pivots must respect validation_pass identity, not generic run scoping

coverage_rows.canon_label: Concern / promotion / graph-patch implications
exact_items: Graph patching implies new run_id, new attempt_id, new node_id; old nodes remain in lineage but do not carry forward primary concern/promotion state
Concern identity must include graph_generation_id so that old concerns (from pre-patch ancestors) are not confused with new concerns (from current patched generation)
Promotion identity must include graph_generation_id and blocked_sequence? so that retried promotions (after recovery or new patch) are not confused with original promotion

Blocked family identity (blocked_reason, blocked_actions, blocked_evidence) must carry graph_generation_id and attempt identity so that blocked state recovery is explicit, not implicit through attempt retry

Concerns and promotions must be stored independently of graph tree mutations; they are logical state, not physical node state; a graph patch that produces new node_id must not require rewriting all historical concerns and promotions from pre-patch ancestors
Show in Concerns and Show in Promotions (reverse pivots) must use graph_generation_id and blocked_sequence identity to disambiguate old vs new states
Query and reporting surfaces (Ledger, History, Evidence) must be able to surface multi-generation concerns and promotions (old + new) without ambiguity

Migration from tier-centric concern/promotion scoping to attempt-centric + blocked_sequence scoping: legacy concerns and promotions tagged with tier_id must be retagged with (graph_generation_id, blocked_sequence?, attempt_id)

Concerns and promotions must be stored independently of graph tree mutations; they are logical state, not physical node state; a graph patch that produces new node_id must not require rewriting all historical concerns and promotions from pre-patch ancestors
Show in Concerns and Show in Promotions (reverse pivots) must use graph_generation_id and blocked_sequence identity to disambiguate old vs new states
Query and reporting surfaces (Ledger, History, Evidence) must be able to surface multi-generation concerns and promotions (old + new) without ambiguity

Migration from tier-centric concern/promotion scoping to attempt-centric + blocked_sequence scoping: legacy concerns and promotions tagged with tier_id must be retagged with (graph_generation_id, blocked_sequence?, attempt_id)
